query: what language do they speak in brazil
answer: People in Brazil speak Portuguese. It is the official and national language, and almost the whole population speaks it [1]. That makes Brazil the largest Portuguese-speaking country in the world by a wide margin, ahead of Angola and Mozambique. It is also the only country in the Americas where Portuguese is the official language [2]. Brazilian Portuguese has noticeable differences from the Portuguese spoken in Portugal, especially in pronunciation and some vocabulary. Other languages are also used in Brazil, including many Indigenous languages, the languages of immigrant communities, and Brazilian Sign Language (Libras) [1].
